title: 第17章 新稀有词条蜘蛛感应第18章 突破聚灵境
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 【为了活下去，你捏着鼻子一头钻了进去！
模拟外的陈奕都忍不住捏了捏鼻子。
【「蜘蛛感应」（绿）：当危险靠近的时候，你会汗毛倒立，起一身鸡皮疙瘩。
陈奕想了想，反正境界卡在了淬体巅峰，哪怕一直修炼，靠自己突破聚灵境也很难。
不如先把“努力必有收获”
【你用「蜘蛛感应」替换了「努力必有收获」。
【凭借「蜘蛛感应」多次对危险做出提前感知，你和老刘在战场上捡了一条命。
【这一战，苏州边军全军覆没，衍关百姓无一幸免。
【孙承恩倒下后，大食军队再无绊脚石，一路长驱直入，连下苏州三十一城，完全攻占一州。
【可笑的是，朝廷依然认为是孙承恩的边军阻敌不力，导致小小的南疆蛮人，竟能占领中原一州。
【得知这些后，老刘告诉你，你以后要隐姓埋名。
【边军虽然全军覆没了，可得到的不是功名，而是罪名，意味着你现在罪上加罪。
content_en:
["Come in quickly!
It's very spacious in here!
No one will ever find out! "
[In order to survive, you hold your nose and dive in!
"Oh~nO..."
Chen Yi outside the simulation couldn't help but pinch his nose.
"'I', 'I', you have suffered again..."
[Sixteenth year, thirty-three years old.
[Extracting entries...]
[Extraction successful!
["Spider Sense" (green): When danger approaches, your hair will stand on end and you will get goosebumps.
[Do you want to adjust the entry? 】
【Whether】
"This is quite useful..."
Chen Yi thought for a while and realized that his realm was stuck at the peak of body tempering anyway. Even if he kept practicing, it would be difficult to break through the spirit gathering realm on his own.
It is better to first put "hard work will be rewarded"
Replace.
Use "Spider Sense"
Improve your own life-saving ability.
[You replaced "hard work will be rewarded" with "spider sense".
[Relying on the "Spider Sense" to sense danger in advance many times, you and Lao Liu saved your lives on the battlefield.
[In this battle, the Suzhou frontier army was completely wiped out, and no one in Yanguan was spared.
[After Sun Chengen fell, the Dashi army no longer had any stumbling blocks. They marched all the way forward, marched down thirty-one cities in Suzhou, and completely captured one state.
[What’s ridiculous is that the imperial court still believed that Sun Chengen’s frontier troops were unable to stop the enemy, which allowed the small barbarians from southern Xinjiang to occupy a state in the Central Plains.
[After learning this, Lao Liu tells you that you must remain anonymous from now on.
[Although the entire border army was wiped out, what they got was not merit but a crime, which means you are now adding more guilt to your crimes.
title_en: Chapter 17 New Rare Entry Spider Sense Chapter 18 Breaking through the Soul Gathering Realm
